newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on Cargill bear spreading.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on Cargill bear spreading.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on Cargill's bear spreading of 700 Jan-May contracts along with spillover pressure from lower CBOT soycomplex values, traders said.

"Cargill was a huge bear spreader, trading 700 Jan-May at $7, locals sold 300 January and then covered shorts on the close," a trader said. Nov-Jan spread at $4.80, Jan-May $7, Jan-Mar $4. November futures crush margin rose to -32.98 from -34.21 Tuesday. Volume was heavy at 9,100 lots, 400 hedges.
November canola fell $4.50 to $395.20, January lost $4.50 to $400.70. November flax fell $4 to $356.50 as Richardson's sold 250 contracts, traders said. Nov-Jan $4.50, Jan-Mar $4.

November western barley lost $1.50 to $138.50 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold and Cargill, UGG bought, traders said. Nov, Feb and March set new lows. February fell $0.50 to $142.10 on spreading. Nov-Feb spread at $3.30 from $2.30, Nov-May $5.30 and May-July at even money. Oats did not trade.
December feed wheat futures lost $0.70 to $168 on commission selling, Midland Walwyn covered March shorts down $0.40 at $167 with commercials selling, traders said.
UGG sold 100 December peas unchanged at US$198.50, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
